harper: Quick sync  assembling the whatsnew bullets for tomorrow's docs deploy. Need someone to eyeball SDK snippets, curl examples, and a concise known-issues list.
leo: on it. which PRs are we including?
harper: main ones: #5201 (whatsnew copy), #5205 (embed examples), #5210 (sdk snippet fixes). Also call out streaming shape changes in known issues.
maya: i can take #5205. quick note: staging shows curl using 'embed_model' while JS uses 'model'  let's pick one and add a redirect.
qin: i'll patch the python streaming sample. new client yields event dicts instead of simple chunk.text. publishable snippet: ```python
for ev in client.generate_stream(model="kestrel", prompt="Hi"):
    if ev.get('type') == 'token':
        print(ev.get('delta', ''), end='')
    elif ev.get('type') == 'done':
        print('\n--done--')
```
leo: add a one-line note above the snippet: "Streaming now emits token and control events (type: 'token'|'done')."
harper: known-issue draft: "Embeddings from quantized backends may differ slightly from float backends; test on representative prompts before switching in production." Keep it short and customer-friendly.
maya: +1. i'll normalize the curl examples to use 'model' and leave a redirect for /embed(s) mismatches.
leo: docs CI: docs-lint passed (build 3341) :white_check_mark:
